==Russian==

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-пасть.ogg}}

===Etymology 1===
{{inh+|ru|orv|пасти}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*pàsti||to fall|id=to fall}}.

====Verb====
{{ru-verb|пасть|pf|impf=па́дать}}

# {{lb|ru|dated|literary}} to [[fall]]
# {{lb|ru|of а decision|especially by lot}} to [[fall]] on an [[option]]
#: {{uxi|ru|[[наш|На́ш]] [[вы́бор]] '''па́л''' [[на]] [[пе́рвый]] [[вариа́нт]].|Our choice '''fell''' on the first option.}}
# {{lb|ru|figurative|high register}} to [[fall]], to [[die]] on the [[battlefield]], to be [[killed in action]]
# {{lb|ru|figurative|formal|of historical states, governments}} to [[fall]], to [[lose]] [[power]], to [[cease]] to [[exist]], to be [[topple]]d
# {{lb|ru|figurative|formal|of historical cities, castles}} to [[fall]], to [[give way]] under [[siege]]
#: {{ux|ru|[[пройти|Прошло́]] ме́ньше ве́ка, [[и]] [[непристу́пный]] [[за́мок]] всё-[[таки́]] '''пал''' [[под]] [[удар|уда́рами]] [[казацкий|каза́цкой]] [[конница|ко́нницы]].|After less than a century, even the impenetrable castle '''fell''' to the blows of the Cossack cavalry.}}
# {{lb|ru|figurative|formal}} to [[stoop]], to [[lower]] one's [[moral]]s
#: {{ux|ru|[[до|До]] [[како́й]] [[степень|сте́пени]] [[на́до]] [[так]] ни́зко '''па́сть''', [[что́бы]] [[пресмыка́ться]] [[перед]] [[тиран|тира́ном]]-[[захватчик|захва́тчиком]], [[кото́рый]] [[мечтать|мечта́ет]] [[поста́вить]] весь [[ми́р]] [[на]] [[колено|коле́ни]]?|To what extent would one have to '''stoop''' so low as to grovel before the tyrant conqueror who wants to put the whole world under his thumb?}}

=====Usage notes=====
* Note that this verb has two past active participle forms: {{m|ru|па́дший}} in the religious/moral sense, and {{m|ru|па́вший}} for all other senses.

=====Conjugation=====
{{ru-conj|pf-intr|7b|пасть|пад}}

===Etymology 2===
Attested since 1731. {{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*pastь}}, from {{m|sla-pro|*pasti||to fall}} + {{m|sla-pro|*-tь}}.

====Noun====

# {{lb|ru|pejorative}} [[mouth]], [[piehole]]
#: {{uxi|ru|[[закрыть|закро́й]] '''пасть'''!|shut up!, shut your piehole!}}
# [[throat]]
# wide [[inlet]] on a device, structure or construction
